title: Elven Star Podcast - Videos
description:
Kevin Ferry hosts the Elven Star Podcast—featuring people who aren’t famous doing great things in their communities. The genesis of Elven Star is Ferry’s belief that humanity’s looking in all the wrong places for guidance, and for answers to life’s difficult questions.

In the technorealm of social media, tweets, follows, re-posts, likes and shares equate with status—even legitimacy. The complex machinery built into its algorithms manipulates & distorts the truth. Conversely, Elven Star present its Guests & their worthy pursuits without any alterations, whatsoever.

Elven Star promotes hard-working, sharing people who, rather than seeking recognition for the passion that fuels their soul, help reconnect us to each other— and to our own humanity. Understanding and building peace starts with putting our trust in our neighbors. By trusting the people in our community instead of those on our screens, we come closer to finding our way back home—the eternal home that resides in each of us.
